pattern: SELECT .+ FROM ([a-zA-Z0-9]+) JOIN ([a-zA-Z0-9]+) ON ([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\_.+ = ([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\_.+ ORDER BY Age ASC LIMIT 1
correction: SELECT required_columns FROM correct_table_name ORDER BY age LIMIT 1

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries that join tables unnecessarily, which may lead to incorrect results. It suggests replacing the query with a correct table reference.
